first:

Contemporary precision paper engineering on a perfectly clean warm-white tabletop, ivory cotton cardstock, charcoal letterpress and tiny vermilion accents, soft upper-left daylight and believable contact shadows. Elevated near-overhead three-quarter camera, minimal lens distortion, entire specimen centered with breathing room.

Subject: one wide ivory diagram sheet, completely FLAT starting state, with three aligned die-cut paper-engineering regions still lying flush in the sheet. Three columns labelled exactly "Choice", "Noul", "Score" in crisp elegant black serif type. Under each exact Chinese definition: Choice "从选项中选择"; Noul "返回“是”的概率"; Score "按明确等级评分". Choice region shows a fine charcoal branching route with three arrow tips printed flat; Noul region shows a flat scored two-leaf gate with the small labels "是" and "否"; Score region shows three scored stair treads printed flat, without numbers. Fine vermilion registration marks discreetly connect each die-cut region to its heading. Conceptual interface metaphor, not a picture of neural architecture.

All three die-cut shapes lie flush, nothing has yet stood up. The typography and shapes are readable, with enough meaningful print to feel like a scholarly designed object. Empty tabletop around the sheet. No other writing, no values or model outputs, no charts pretending to be measurements, no digital dashboard, no collage, no book, no antique decoration, no gold, no flowers, no neon, no watermark.
